label: Lakewood

county_election_office.name: Jefferson County Elections, 3500 Illinois St., Suite 1100, Golden 80401

zip_caveats: 80214 also covers Edgewater and parts of Wheat Ridge and Denver; 80215 includes Wheat Ridge; 80227 and 80235 include unincorporated Jeffco (Bear Creek, Fort Logan area) and a bit of Denver; 80401 is mostly Golden and unincorporated Jeffco with a slice of west Lakewood; 80123 touches southeast Lakewood, Bow Mar and Littleton. All of Lakewood is in Congressional District 7, so every Lakewood voter sees the CD-7 races for U.S. House, State Board of Education and CU Regent. State Senate: roughly, District 20 is the part of Lakewood south of Alameda Ave (south of Mississippi Ave east of Wadsworth) and District 22 is north of that. State House: roughly, District 28 is south of Jewell Ave; north of Jewell, District 30 is east of about Kipling and District 23 is west of it. RTD: most of Lakewood is in RTD District M or D, which have no election this year; only the south end (roughly west of Wadsworth and south of Jewell) is in District N. These lines are approximate, from Census district maps checked Oct 17; your mailed ballot or the Secretary of State's ballot lookup is exact. All Lakewood voters see the Jefferson County races (commissioner, clerk, treasurer, assessor, sheriff, surveyor, coroner), the 1st Judicial District and Jefferson County Court judges, city questions 2G to 2J, Jeffco Schools 5A and 5B, West Metro Fire 7C (most of the city) and rail 7A.
